content.title: MGPI Q2 Deep Dive: Branded Spirits Focus and Cost Actions Amid Industry Headwinds
content.summary: Food and beverage supplier MGP Ingredients (NASDAQ:MGPI) reported Q2 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 23.7% year on year to $145.5 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $530 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 47.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
